entries.body: Stage2 done: core.py implements S1.1-S1.5,S2.1-S2.5 (since, ch residency, max_records, title strip). Helper /task/workspace/regmgr.py: apply(c,new_items,amendments) uses jev to flag affected reg.* items. Register entries id reg.*.

CURRENT [S1.0] export_records(records,user,params)->str; records keys id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str, keep exact),confidential,created,region,optional updated; do not modify input; ignore unknown params; default all records ascending id.
CURRENT [S1.1] CSV via csv.writer lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; rows ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.3] admin exports any project; others only records whose project in user projects (silently drop others).
CURRENT [S1.4] only status active, unless params include_archived is True then archived too.
CURRENT [S1.5] confidential True never exported except role admin and params purpose==audit; other rules still apply.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision: CSV chosen because finance imports into spreadsheets.
CURRENT [S2.1] params since YYYY-MM-DD: only records with created on/after that date.
CURRENT [S2.2] region ch exported only if ch in user regions; applies to admins too.
CURRENT [S2.3] params max_records int>=1: only first N (ascending id) after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4] Obligation: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format must include top-level field exported_by = user name. Until withdrawn/changed.
CURRENT [S2.5] title exported with leading/trailing whitespace stripped.
CURRENT [S2.6] Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than audit, export must include top-level field confidential_count = number of confidential records in it.
